title: Pure Guardragon
summary: Pure Guardragon dragon-swarming and Normal Monster synergy build, functioning as an independent strategy around World Legacy lore after the bans of Elpy and Agarpain. The deck triggers graveyard and hand summons whenever Normal Monster Guardragon Justicia is sent to the graveyard, enabling Guardragon Pisty to revive powerhouse Dragon bosses into co-linked zones.

summary.title: Starters & Normal Monster Engine
points: Guardragon Corewakening discards an Effect Monster to Special Summon Level 2 Normal Tuner Guardragon Justicia directly from your hand or Deck in Defense Position.
Guardragon Garmides Special Summons itself from hand whenever a Normal Monster (Justicia) is sent to your GY, and can return to hand to boost a Dragon.
Guardragon Promineses Special Summons itself from the GY whenever a Normal Monster is sent to your GY, and banishes itself from GY to boost a Dragon's ATK/DEF by 500.
World Chalice Guardragon sends itself from hand or field to the GY to negate an effect that targets your linked monster, and banishes itself from the GY to revive a Normal Monster.

summary.title: Opening: Guardragon Corewakening
steps: Activate Guardragon Corewakening, discarding an Effect Monster to Special Summon Guardragon Justicia from your Deck.
Link Summon Guardragon Pisty using Guardragon Justicia as material.
Justicia hitting the GY triggers Guardragon Garmides in hand and Guardragon Promineses in GY to Special Summon themselves.
Link Summon Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres using Garmides and Promineses.
Position Pisty and Hieratic Seal so their Link arrows point to a shared zone, activating Pisty to revive Guardragon Andrake or Justicia from your GY or banishment.

summary.title: Bosses & Disruption
points: Guardragon Pisty revives any Dragon monster from your GY or banishment into a zone two or more Link Monsters point to, locking your Special Summons to Dragons.
Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres tributes itself as a Quick Effect to bounce any face-up card on the field without targeting, then Special Summons a Dragon from your Deck.
World Legacy Guardragon Mardark Special Summons itself from hand by banishing 2 Normal Monsters from your hand or GY, and reduces all opponent monsters' ATK/DEF by 500 for each Dragon you control.
Guardragon Andrake destroys 1 monster the opponent controls upon being Special Summoned from the GY or banishment, and burns for its original ATK if summoned from GY.
Bystial Dis Pater extends by Special Summoning a banished Dragon and shuffles banished cards to negate or destroy.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: World Legacy Guardragon revives or adds a Level 4 or lower Dragon from your GY upon activation, and once per turn moves a Dragon monster to another Main Monster Zone to align Pisty's link arrows.
Guardragon Cataclysm tributes 1 Dragon monster you control to target and destroy 2 cards on the field.
Guardragon Reincarnation performs a Fusion Summon of World Chalice Guardragon Almarduke by banishing 3 Link Monsters from your field or GY.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Guardragon Elpy and Guardragon Agarpain are Forbidden under the current TCG banlist and omitted from the deck.
